raw_response:
I am 70 years old. I never went to school. I have farmed these 8 mu in Quzhou for 50 years. My husband died twelve years ago. Now it is just me and my youngest son, but he works as a builder in Handan city and only comes back at harvest time. So I am the one in the field every day.

I grow cotton on all 8 mu. I only know cotton. Last year I planted cotton, this year I plant cotton. I buy the improved seed from Old Wang's seed shop in the township. It costs 38 yuan per jin. I use 3 jin of seed per mu. Everyone in our village buys the same seed — the bag with the pink stripe and the picture of white cotton. I cannot read the words, but I know that bag.

For fertilizer, at planting time in late April I spread one big bag of the mixed fertilizer on each mu. The bag weighs 50 kilograms. It has three numbers on it, and Old Wang says it is 15-15-15 or something close. The grains are different colors — white, black, and red. Then when the cotton starts flowering in July, I put half a bag of white fertilizer — urea — on each mu. Half a bag is 25 kilograms. My neighbor Zhang used a full bag of urea per mu last year and his cotton grew very tall and green, so this year I thought about doing the same. But urea is 125 yuan a bag now, and the mixed fertilizer is 155 yuan. For 8 mu that is a lot of money. Still, I would rather spend too much than too little. If the cotton fails, I have no money to buy medicine. Wasting fertilizer is just a cost. Losing the crop is a disaster. I also bought two cartloads of chicken manure from the farm down the road for 200 yuan total. I spread that on the whole field before planting.

I irrigate 4 times. I have a well with an electric pump. First time right after planting to wake up the seeds. Second time when the plants are up to my knee. Third time when the white and yellow flowers open. Fourth time when the bolls are big and fat and need water to fill. Each time costs electricity, but I have to do it.

For bugs, I spray 5 times. Cotton always gets worms, even with the improved seed. I hire Liu from the village to bring his spray machine. He charges 10 yuan per mu each time. I cannot carry the tank on my back anymore — my spine hurts. First spray when the plants are small. Then every ten days or so. The last spray is before the bolls start to crack open.

For tillage, I call the man with the rotary machine. He comes with his tractor and turns the soil once before I plant. He charges 40 yuan per mu. It is fast. We do not plough with oxen like when I was a girl.

Last year I got about 460 jin of seed cotton per mu. This year I hope for 480 jin, maybe 500 jin if the summer rain comes at the right time. That is around 240 to 250 kilograms per mu. I sell to the buyer who drives his truck to the village edge. I need this money to live and to pay for my blood pressure pills.

I plant improved cotton seed on all 8 mu in the spring, applying one 50 kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu at planting and half a bag of urea per mu at flowering, which works out to about 22 kg of nitrogen, 8 kg of phosphorus, and 8 kg of potassium per mu. I irrigate four times from my well, hire a village machine to spray pesticide five times because I cannot carry the tank anymore, and pay for rotary tillage once before planting.
